blocks.text: The Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) joined the “MANA Mo 2026” initiative held in Barangay Pag-asa, Kalayaan, Palawan, on September 25, 2026, providing 300 ChariTimba food buckets for residents. PCSO Assistant General Manager for Management Services Sector Arnel Casas led the agency’s participation in the activity, alongside officials and representatives from various government agencies. Despite the geopolitical challenges in the West Philippine Sea, the government continues to extend assistance and services to the residents of Pag-asa Island as part of its efforts to support the welfare and development of the island community.
